title: Action Execution Result
description: Structured outcome of one action-request execution attempt, produced by a capability-gated action executor. Always produced for every attempt, including rejected/failed/duplicate outcomes - the executor never throws.

status.description: executed: the provider ran and returned a result. duplicate: an identical request was already executed; not re-executed. rejected: the request never reached execution (unsupported type, missing capability, unauthorized, or invalid payload). failed: the provider was invoked but threw.

actionType.description: Echoed from the source action request. Null only when the request itself failed validation (INVALID_REQUEST) and the field could not be read safely.

sequence.description: Echoed from the source action request. Null only for INVALID_REQUEST.

correlationId.description: Echoed from the source action request. Null only for INVALID_REQUEST.

ruleId.description: Echoed from the source action request. Null only for INVALID_REQUEST.

result.description: The provider's own return value. Populated only when status is "executed" or "duplicate" (the original executed result). Null otherwise.

details.description: Optional structured diagnostic (e.g. validation error text) for rejected/failed outcomes. Null otherwise.
